data.one_liner: A Flutter dialog widget to select single or multiple items from a list.
data.what_it_does: Provides a modal dialog that displays a list of items for the user to pick one or many. Supports optional search, custom label widgets, and callbacks for selection changes.
use_when: You need a quick, out‑of‑the‑box selection dialog
You want built‑in search or multiple‑item selection
You prefer a lightweight solution without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You require a fully custom picker UI
You need platform‑specific pickers (e.g., native iOS picker)
You need advanced theming or accessibility features not provided
strengths: Very easy to integrate with a single showModal call
Supports both single and multiple selection
Search box and customizable label widget
weaknesses: Relies on an internal copy of rxdart, which may cause version conflicts
No built‑in theming or accessibility enhancements
